data.name: IAH: INTERNET WAR
data.detailed_description:
IAH: INTERNET WAR is a tactical roguelite that combines turn-based planning with real-time squad combat. Stop ZENDAR CORP from placing the world under the control of a global AI. Play solo or in online co-op for 2 to 10 players.

EXPLORE THE INTERNET


Navigate a labyrinth of connected rooms containing websites, enemies and valuable resources. Capture Control Panels to secure territory and unlock illegal contracts.

Every action advances one turn. Browse the network, buy equipment, build bots or move deeper into the labyrinth, and the internet responds.

FIGHT IN REAL TIME


Command your bots on a 3D battlefield. Move them, select targets, set combat stances and use their skills. Cover, flanking and line of sight affect every fight. Tactical Mode gives you direct control when precision matters.

SURVIVE THE RESPONSE


Completing contracts increases your wanted level. Police become stronger, rival hackers trace you and enemy crews attack your operation.

Each wave presents three Chaos cards, and you must choose one. Counter their effects with weapons, equipment, items and permanent upgrades.

Protect your Main Bot. If it dies, the run ends. Your score unlocks new hackers, bot improvements and crafting parts for future runs.

FEATURES


  • Single-player and online co-op for 2 to 10 players
  • A labyrinth of rooms and websites to explore
  • Turn-based planning and real-time tactical combat
  • Cover, flanking, line of sight and direct unit control
  • 400+ Chaos cards, weapons and items
  • 100+ bots and structures
  • Eight hackers with different bots, bonuses and drawbacks
  • Bot crafting and permanent progression
